
```{r}

ice_mask <- CDRv6() |>
  cdo_gtc(0.15) |>
  cdo_ymonmean() |>
  cdo_expr("'mask=aice > 0.05 ? 0 : missval(aice)'") |>
  _[]

stl_df <- function(x, years, w = 10) {
  year1 <- years[1]
  stl_decomp <- ts(x, start = c(year1, 1), frequency = 12) |>
    stl(s.window = w, t.window = 12 * w)
  list(
    anom = as.numeric(stl_decomp$time.series[, 3]),
    trend = as.numeric(stl_decomp$time.series[, 2]),
    seasonal = as.numeric(stl_decomp$time.series[, 1])
  )
}
```

```{r}
sst_t2m <- list(sst = ERA5_sst(), t2m = ERA5_t2m()) |>
  purrr::imap(\(file, name) {
    file |>
      cdo_ymonadd(ice_mask) |>
      cdo_fldmean() |>
      _[] |>
      ReadNetCDF(c(value = name)) |>
      _[, variable := name] |>
      _[]
  }) |>
  rbindlist() |>
  _[,
    c("anom", "trend", "seasonal") := stl_df(value, year(time), w = 10),
    by = variable
  ]
```


```{r}
sst_t2m |>
  copy() |>
  _[, seasonal := scale(seasonal), by = variable] |>
  ggplot(aes(time, seasonal)) +
  geom_line(aes(color = variable))
```

```{r}
sst_t2m |>
  copy() |>
  _[, anom := scale(anom + trend), by = variable] |>
  ggplot(aes(time, anom)) +
  geom_line(aes(color = variable))
```

```{r}
sst_t2m |>
  copy() |>
  _[, anom := scale(anom), by = variable] |>
  ggplot(aes(time, anom)) +
  geom_line(aes(color = variable))
```

```{r}
sst_t2m |>
  copy() |>
  _[, sd := frollsd(anom, n = 120), by = variable] |>
  _[, sd := scale(sd), by = variable] |>
  ggplot(aes(time, sd)) +
  geom_line(aes(color = variable))
```
